packageRules.description: For any APK package in a Dockerfile, only allow patch and pin updates. This enforces the 'major.minor.x' pinning strategy.
For any Docker FROM image, allow minor and patch updates.
Group all updates by their source Dockerfile to create logical PRs.

The example Go app's go directive is read by the scanner as the Go standard library it was built with, so it names the exact Go that go-base ships and follows its patches. Capped below the next minor: a go 1.27 floor would not build on go-base's Go 1.26. Raise the cap when go-base moves to a new Go line. ignorePaths is the ignoreModulesAndTests list with **/examples/** narrowed so that only examples/go-app is visible: the other examples stay unmanaged, as before.

Scanner versions are pinned in two places each (the action or installer, and a NAME_VERSION env var). Move them in one PR so the two never disagree, and apart from unrelated bumps because a scanner bump can turn the whole fleet red.
